_help: Day 1, room 6: the shed, 'Bucket and spade' (2001-2002). The note on the workbench only shows with the light on; the shell counts on the bucket lid; Chloé's brush; the ribbons and the red bicycle. See docs/STORY.md.

locks._why: The side gate key was in the bicycle basket.
hints: The way round to the front garden is still locked.
The key from the bicycle basket opens the side door.
Select the brass key, then tap the side door.

locks._why: 'You never did beat that very first day': the first number on the bucket lid, 23.
hints: It's too dark to read in here. And then: which day was the best?
The numbers on the lid of the little red bucket (among the flower buckets) belong to the workbench's left drawer.

locks._why: Chloé keeps bumping into things: her fringe is in her eyes. Her brush was in the workbench drawer.
hints: Her fringe is over her eyes, and her brush was in the workbench.
Select the brush, then tap Chloé.

locks._why: Something fell under the workbench; only Chloé fits.
hints: Something fell where only a small dog can go.
Chloé can fetch from under the workbench.
Tap Chloé, then tap under the workbench.

locks._why: The first ribbon on the pegboard is from 2001; the red bicycle came the summer after: 2002.
hints: When did the red bicycle come?
The ribbons on the pegboard and the ribbons note belong to the bicycle.
The first ribbon is 2001, the bicycle came the summer after: 2002.

clues.text: Among Mamie's zinc flower buckets hides a small red child's bucket. On its lid, in felt pen, a column of numbers, each one crossed out by the next: 23, 19, 21, 17, 20.
Among the tools hang three faded ribbons: MOST SHELLS · 2001, MOST SHELLS · 2002, MOST SHELLS · 2003.
